_comment: Phase 3 starts with 5 sources. URLs and CSS selectors MUST be verified with the user before activating a watcher. Expand to 25+ in Phase 5.

watchers.name: CDAC (Centre for Development of Advanced Computing)
watchers.notes: Frequently hires Project Engineers in electronics/CS. Verify URL at https://www.cdac.in/index.aspx?id=st_car_opportunity

watchers.name: NIELIT (National Institute of Electronics & IT)
watchers.notes: Hires Scientists, Technical Assistants. Verify URL at https://www.nielit.gov.in/content/vacancies

watchers.name: CSIR Labs (CEERI, CSIO, NPL, etc.)
watchers.notes: CSIR labs hire via individual lab career pages and common CSIR portal. Verify URLs for each lab.

watchers.name: ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation)
watchers.notes: Hires Scientists/Engineers, Technical Assistants, Scientific Assistants. Verified active URL.

watchers.name: BEL (Bharat Electronics Limited)
watchers.notes: PSU hiring Project/Contract Engineers. Verify URL at https://www.bel-india.in/career.aspx

google_alerts_rss.name: Google Alerts — Government Job Notifications
google_alerts_rss.notes: User will provide RSS feed URLs from Google Alerts. Treat as supplement to watchers only.

aggregators.name: Sarkari Result Latest Jobs
aggregators.notes: Scrapes latest job postings to discover official government notification PDFs and apply portals.

health_check.note: If a watcher or Google Alerts feed shows no new items for 7+ days, send a Telegram alert about possible breakage.
